newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bezeq Israel Telecom Q4 EPS 0.27 shekel.
newsitem.headline: Bezeq Israel Telecom Q4 EPS 0.27 shekel.

text.p: Bezeq, Israel's main telecommunications carrier, said a major part of revenues growth last year was due to its Pelephone cellular telephone subsidiary, which it jointly controls with Motorola Israel.
A sharp increase in the number of overall phone lines also helped revenue growth by increasing monthly fees and end-user equipment sales, the company said. This offset a decline in tariffs, it added.

Bezeq said it installed 415,000 new lines, an 18 percent increase from 1995, for a total of 2.55 million lines, an 8.7 percent increase. It added that the digitalisation of the phone network was completed last year.

Return on capital fell in 1996 to 12.3 percent from 12.5 percent in 1995, Bezeq said. It estimated royalties due to the government, which owns 76 percent of the company, would reach 415 million shekels for last year.
The company said in invested 2.8 billion shekels in capital equipment last year, up from 2.1 billion shekels in 1995.
"Bezeq and its subsidiaries are continuing their policy of high levels of infrastructure investment," the company said.
